rationale: The stock gapped down 5.2% on 6x relative volume in a risk-off tape, but has since stalled exactly at session VWAP ($27.45 vs $27.46) at only 37% of its range, with the last five one-minute bars showing volume collapsing to hundreds of shares and a range tighter than one 5m ATR. That is the least informative state possible: no continuation selling into lows, but also no absorption-driven reclaim, and the missing headline behind the gap leaves the fundamental driver unknown. With a roughly 0.5%-reward-versus-1%-risk geometry in either direction and $603 of daily loss budget left, forcing a coin-flip at VWAP midday is the worst available option.
